fields.description: Issue features an extended investigative exposé alleging abusive and manipulative practices by Miami physician Dr. T. Earl Moore (the "Torture Doctor"), including claims of drugging/hypnosis, influence over the Koenig family and Paul's Boat Supply Co., and discussion of the death of Ella Head (found burned). Additional content includes an editorial/feature advocating municipal ownership of utilities and criticizing Florida Power & Light rates; local court and public-safety reports on children causing train wrecks in the Hialeah area and an article on a perceived rise in sex offenses involving children; a long reprinted/attributed medical-policy piece on polio funding and the rivalry between the March of Dimes (NFIP) and the Sister Kenny Foundation; and letters to the editor (including on Miami's condition and a defense of the Salvation Army).
